scripts.music: node scripts/generate-music.mjs scripts/promo-beat.wav && remotion ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i scripts/promo-beat.wav -c:a libmp3lame -b:a 192k public/music/promo-beat.mp3 && rm scripts/promo-beat.wav
scripts.zohar-audio: node scripts/generate-zohar-audio.mjs scripts/zohar-wav && for f in music rumble heartbeat riser chime pop; do remotion ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i scripts/zohar-wav/$f.wav -c:a libmp3lame -b:a 192k public/zohar/audio/$f.mp3; done && rm -r scripts/zohar-wav
scripts.kardan-music: node scripts/generate-kardan-music.mjs scripts/kardan.wav && remotion ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i scripts/kardan.wav -c:a libmp3lame -b:a 192k public/kardan/music.mp3 && rm scripts/kardan.wav
scripts.dream9-audio: node scripts/generate-dream9-audio.mjs scripts/dream9-wav && mkdir -p public/dream9/audio && for f in music bassdrop swoosh cash pop ticker stamp ticktock click riser; do remotion ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i scripts/dream9-wav/$f.wav -c:a libmp3lame -b:a 192k public/dream9/audio/$f.mp3; done && rm -r scripts/dream9-wav
